core_obligations: Reduce to the affine local case (proof lines 6865-6875): the assertion is local on Y and on U, so the author assumes the schemes affine and the morphism of the relevant algebraic type.

Construct the liftings (proof lines 6875-6883): using the standard lifting of syntomic, smooth and etale morphisms along a closed immersion, the author produces morphisms V_i -> Y and morphisms of their base changes to U which form a Zariski covering of U.
proof_roadmap: Localise on the base and on U to reach the affine case.
Apply the lifting result for syntomic, smooth and etale morphisms along a closed immersion.
Assemble the local liftings into a Zariski covering of U.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a syntomic, smooth or etale morphism U -> X over a closed subscheme X of Y can be covered Zariski locally by base changes of morphisms of the same type over Y (statement lines 6856-6863). The proof reduces to the affine case by locality (proof lines 6865-6875) and then applies the standard lifting result for morphisms of these types along a closed immersion (proof lines 6875-6883), assembling the local pieces into a Zariski covering. The non-formal content is the application of the lifting result. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one assembly.
